source_and_task_policy: Reuse previously consumed MR19 development-only original Farama DoorKey(size=5), Empty(size=8), seeds 41,43,47,53 and their fixed training/dev action scripts; no new unknown tasks or seeds.
measurement: Use original MiniGrid reset/step; count changes in original MR15 observer-relative 8 local image samples caused by true native camera rotation action, while evaluator checks unmodified original grid bytes and unchanged agent position.
observation_truth_scope: Evaluator-only original native world grid/agent coordinates can prove whether camera rotation rather than local world-cell mutation generated image changes. No learner, comparator or action policy receives privileged source truth.
test_hypotheses: Native rotation actions alter camera heading without changing the original underlying world grid or agent position.
A rotation can change multiple MR15 observer-relative sensor positions in a single native event, so those positions cannot be assumed independent world-anchored causal agents.
Co-change is descriptive, not proof that any physical/world causal module cannot be learned.
reported_metrics: Original source and Git blob custody
turn steps with grid and agent position unchanged
turn steps with >=1 and >=2 MR15 local change bits
max simultaneously changed spatial sample slots per turn
required_qualifications_before_integrati: G29 atlas source exact pin and full Windows/Linux regression
